model_target: Aegis Phone Number Pattern Risk Model (AEGIS-PNP1)

features.name: num_is_valid_e164
features.description: 1.0 if number strictly satisfies ITU-T E.164 syntax and valid country dial code

features.name: num_national_length_normalized
features.description: National number digit count normalized against country standard (len / 15.0)

features.name: num_length_discrepancy
features.description: Absolute discrepancy from standard national length (|len - std_len| / 15.0)

features.name: digit_shannon_entropy
features.description: Normalized Shannon entropy of national digits (H / 3.3219)

features.name: digit_unique_ratio
features.description: Ratio of unique digits to total national digits (unique / total)

features.name: digit_max_repeat_run
features.description: Maximum contiguous repetition of identical digits (max_run / 10.0)

features.name: digit_max_sequential_asc
features.description: Maximum contiguous ascending sequential run (max_asc / 10.0)

features.name: digit_max_sequential_desc
features.description: Maximum contiguous descending sequential run (max_desc / 10.0)

features.name: digit_alternating_pattern_density
features.description: Density of alternating 2-digit pairs e.g. 121212 or 505050 (count / (len-1))

features.name: digit_repeated_block_density
features.description: Density of repeated 2-digit/3-digit blocks e.g. 123123 (count / (len-2))

features.name: digit_palindrome_symmetry
features.description: Levenshtein/reversal symmetry ratio of national digits [0.0 - 1.0]

features.name: digit_trailing_zeros_count
features.description: Normalized count of trailing zeros in national number (count / 8.0)

features.name: digit_leading_digit_distribution
features.description: Illegal leading digit indicator (e.g. leading 0 or 1 in NANP or 0 in mobile)

features.name: plan_is_tollfree
features.description: ITU-T E.164 Toll-Free designation (1800, 800, 888, 877, 866)

features.name: plan_is_premium_rate
features.description: High-charge Premium-Rate service series (1900, 900, 0900)

features.name: plan_is_shared_cost
features.description: Shared cost dialer range

features.name: plan_is_voip_virtual
features.description: Fixed VoIP / cloud PBX virtual carrier allocation

features.name: plan_is_mobile
features.description: Standard cellular mobile allocation

features.name: plan_is_fixed_line
features.description: Standard geographic PSTN landline

features.name: plan_is_uan_shortcode
features.description: Universal Access Number (UAN) or government/emergency shortcode

features.name: risk_wangiri_high_cost_prefix
features.description: International high-cost / revenue-sharing prefix (+881, +882, +247, +232, +252, etc.)

features.name: risk_telemarketing_series
features.description: Domestic commercial telemarketing / bulk automated dialer series

features.name: risk_unallocated_exchange_code
features.description: NPA-NXX exchange code marked unassigned or reserved in public telecom registries

features.name: risk_short_code_spoofing
features.description: Alphanumeric / shortcode formatted illegally as international E.164

features.name: hard_neg_legitimate_bank_support
features.description: Verified public customer care / toll-free bank pattern (1800-11-2211, 1800-425-3800)

features.name: hard_neg_emergency_service
features.description: Recognized national emergency / public utility number (112, 911, 999, 100)

features.name: geo_is_same_country
features.description: 1.0 if incoming number country matches user device default country/SIM

features.name: geo_country_risk_tier
features.description: Country code historical telecom fraud risk index [0.0 - 1.0]

features.name: joint_wangiri_callback_trap
features.description: Foreign high-cost prefix + low entropy or length discrepancy

features.name: joint_voip_robocall_pattern
features.description: Virtual VoIP range + repetitive sequential digit pattern

features.name: joint_spoofed_short_dialer
features.description: Length discrepancy + premium rate or unallocated exchange code

features.name: joint_telemarketer_block
features.description: Telemarketing prefix + low unique digit ratio

features.name: digit_variance_density
features.description: Normalized variance of digit frequency distribution (variance / 5.0)

features.name: digit_consecutive_diff_sum
features.description: Normalized sum of absolute differences between adjacent digits (sum / (9.0 * (len-1)))

features.name: plan_is_personal_number
features.description: Personal follow-me number allocation

features.name: plan_is_pager
features.description: Pager system allocation
